tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Get service capabilities, membership quota policies, and real-time platform statistics of Gooo Short (好縮 short.gooo.name / s.gooo.name). Use when the user asks what Gooo Short can do, quota limits, or overall platform metrics (alias: get_stats_overview).

tools.name: create_short_url
tools.description: Create a short link (s.gooo.name) for an HTTP or HTTPS URL (compatible with shorten_url). Use when the user explicitly requests URL shortening, custom short codes, password protection, or link tagging. Automatically associates the link with the user's account when authenticated.

tools.name: get_link_info
tools.description: Retrieve metadata and status of a specific short link by its short code or full short URL (compatible with get_url_info). Returns original URL, webpage title, click count, tags, password status, and creation/expiration time.

tools.name: list_my_links
tools.description: List short links belonging to the currently authenticated user account (or current session). Supports optional filtering by tag and result count limit.

tools.name: get_link_analytics
tools.description: Query click analytics, top referers, and recent click logs for a specific short link.

tools.name: update_short_url
tools.description: Update an existing short link's title, category tags, or public visibility on the user's profile. Requires the user to be authenticated and own the link.

tools.name: delete_short_url
tools.description: Permanently delete a short link and release its quota back to the user's account. This is a destructive operation and requires authentication and ownership of the link.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get the current authenticated user's profile, email, membership tier (Free / Pro), and active short link quota usage (compatible with get_account_status).

tools.name: check_code_availability
tools.description: Check whether a custom short code (minimum 5 characters) is available and not a reserved system keyword.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Generate a 10-minute one-time authorization link (Magic Link) to bind the current MCP session to a Gooo Short user account via Google Login.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Unbind the current MCP session from the linked Gooo Short user account and return to guest mode.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_short_url" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_link_info, get_user_profile · Private data: create_short_url, get_link_info · Public sink: get_user_profile · Destructive: delete_short_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_link_info, get_user_profile · Private data: create_short_url, get_link_info · Public sink: get_user_profile · Destructive: delete_short_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
